source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: IMAPServer.addMessages accepts a mailbox-name string or a folder object. Both paths add messages to the fake mailbox. Only a folder object with update enabled waits for updateFolderAndNotify; a string returns a resolved promise after injection. The Thundermail URL test seeds INBOX by string before account creation. Awaiting that call does not prove a client has downloaded the messages; later message-count and idle waits are separate checks. No browser test ran.
title: Mailbox-name injection does not wait for a client folder update
